name: ENKI Completeness Vocabulary Pack
description: Defines the four card completeness tiers (stub, partial, solid, verified) and the per-node-type slot specifications that determine how completeness is computed. Every card carries a completeness score and tier; this pack defines what those scores mean and which slots each subtype requires.

metadata.author: ENKI System
metadata.change_control: Tier thresholds and slot specs adjustable via Tier 1 vocabulary extension. Adding a new tier requires full ceremony.
